stories.title: ChatGPT adds Live Dictation that transcribes as you speak
stories.summary: OpenAI rolled out Live Dictation in ChatGPT, transcribing speech in real time instead of waiting until the user finishes recording, across web, desktop, and mobile apps on all plans.
stories.more: Live Dictation lets ChatGPT transcribe audio prompts as the user speaks, rather than waiting until they finish recording. OpenAI is rolling the feature out globally across the web, desktop app, and iOS and Android apps, on all ChatGPT plans.

stories.title: Verge reporter tests Apple and Amazon's always-listening AI wearables
stories.summary: A Verge reporter spent two weeks testing Apple's Siri Recap on the Apple Watch Ultra 4 and Amazon's Bee Frontier, both wearables that ambiently listen to conversations and use AI to summarize them.
stories.more: Both products enable a wearable device to continuously listen to conversations and generate AI summaries of what was discussed. The review set out to test whether that ambient listening and summarization proved worthwhile over an extended period of use.

stories.title: Canva adds a button to turn off its AI features
stories.summary: Canva now lets users disable its generative AI tools, including the photo-extending Magic Expand feature and its chatbot's image generation, though the toggle doesn't disable every AI-powered feature.
stories.more: The new toggle lets users turn off specific generative AI tools within the design platform, such as the photo-extending Magic Expand feature. It also allows disabling image generation through Canva's built-in chatbot. Canva clarified that the off switch does not disable every AI-powered feature in the product.

stories.title: OpenAI researchers value coding agents over nearly half their colleagues
stories.summary: OpenAI researchers increasingly rely on internal coding agents, whose theoretical token costs now exceed base salaries, and said they value the tools more than nearly half of their colleagues, despite the agents still producing a lot of "AI slop."
stories.more: OpenAI's internal use of coding agents is growing quickly, and the theoretical token cost of that usage now exceeds researchers' base salaries. Teams are reportedly reluctant to work without the tools, and researchers say they value them more than nearly half of their colleagues. Even so, the models still produce a substantial amount of "AI slop" beyond routine, well-defined tasks.

stories.title: Anthropic goes public in record-breaking $81.3 billion IPO
stories.summary: Anthropic went public in the largest IPO in history, raising $81.3 billion and surpassing SpaceX's record, as CEO Dario Amodei used his Nasdaq opening-bell speech to recommit to pacing AI development despite business and political pressure.
stories.more: The IPO raised $81.3 billion, dethroning SpaceX as the previous record holder for a public debut. At the Nasdaq opening bell, Amodei reiterated Anthropic's commitment to pacing AI development regardless of business or political pressure. TechCrunch reports the company faces enormous compute commitments as it goes public, though infrastructure partners Amazon and Google could keep profiting from AI even if Anthropic loses its lead. Early investor Dustin Moskovitz has publicly distanced himself from the company, saying his early funding may have been an act "that ended the world." Wired notes investors will be weighing whether Anthropic's AI safety strategy and growing public anger toward data centers could affect its growth.
